thread:
Sam: Found a couple of broken anchors in the runtime guide during canary tests -> 404 on /runtime/anchors#kv-cache and /runtime/anchors#routing. Anyone owns that section?
Priya: thanks for the ping — I can take the shortfix. do you have the exact URLs?
Sam: links (staging canary): https://staging.redwood.dev/docs/runtime/anchors#kv-cache and https://staging.redwood.dev/docs/runtime/anchors#routing. quick grep I used: `rg "anchors#" docs/runtime -n`
Jordan: heads-up — those anchors moved in my last refactor PR (moved headings to H3). i'll open a tiny PR to add alias anchors + redirects. sorry for the churn.
Priya: cool. can you also update CODEOWNERS for that subtree? linter flagged runtime/anchors as ownerless.
Jordan: yep — will include a CODEOWNERS tweak and a redirect. pinging @Maya for a quick review before lunch :pray:
Maya: on it, will take a look in ~20m. if it's trivial i can merge before 12:30.
docs-bot: docs-linter: :warning: anchor-check failed on PR #1234 — missing _redirects entry for /docs/runtime/anchors. Triggered by @Jordan.
Ken: if we merge, can we add a tiny smokecheck to the canary workflow so this doesn't slip through again? e.g. add `curl -fsS https://staging.redwood.dev/docs/runtime/anchors || exit 1` as a post-deploy step.
Priya: :thumbsup: Ken, please add that as a follow-up PR. Jordan, once your PR is up, tag me and i'll claim ownership + add a one-liner to the owners doc.
Jordan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1259 — includes anchor aliases, a redirect file, and a CODEOWNERS tweak. cc @Priya @Maya
Maya: LGTM, left 1 nit about wording in the redirect comment. CI is running, will merge after checks pass.
Sam: thanks! re-running the canary smoke now — looks clean. :tada: QA ticket QA-4823 ready for re-check.
Priya: claiming runtime/anchors ownership for the next sprint, will add to the owners doc and small changelog entry.
Maya: sweet. also — lunch later? :sandwich:
Sam: count me in :wave:
